title: done's ledger guard accepts the anchor rows an anchor --file run prunes or re-anchors for an article the goal names
goal: An _anchors.csv row added, dropped or changed for a fact of an article the item's goal names by path passes done's ledger rows check, so BG-xweoljdy's per-file anchor runs in SP-uvz65lvm land without 44 source ids pasted into its goal

run:
import subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import backlog, bl_land
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@example.com", *a], cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
root = tmp / "kb" / "public"
(root / "x").mkdir(parents=True)
(root / "y").mkdir()
for n in ("x/a.md", "y/b.md"):
    (root / n).write_text("# t\n")
head = "fact,path,source_id,status,heading,terms,sha,quote,verified_utc\n"
row = lambda f, p, s, st: f"{f},{p},{s},{st},,,,,2026-10-10\n"
led = root / "_anchors.csv"
led.write_text(head + row("aaaaaaaaaaaa", "x/a.md", "S100", "located") + row("bbbbbbbbbbbb", "y/b.md", "S101", "located"))
git("init", "-q")
git("add", "-A")
git("commit", "-q", "-m", "base")
led.write_text(head + row("aaaaaaaaaaaa", "x/a.md", "S100", "unlocated:no-match") + row("bbbbbbbbbbbb", "y/b.md", "S101", "located")
               + row("cccccccccccc", "x/a.md", "S300", "located") + row("dddddddddddd", "y/b.md", "S400", "located"))
git("add", "-A")
git("commit", "-q", "-m", "anchors\n\nKB-Work: ST-aaaaaaaa")
sha = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
fake = SimpleNamespace(items={"ST-aaaaaaaa": {"goal": "anchor the facts of kb/public/x/a.md with anchor --file", "title": "anchor run"}}, descendants=lambda i: [])
left = dict(bl_land.unrelated_baselines(fake, "ST-aaaaaaaa", str(tmp), {sha: ["kb/public/_anchors.csv"]}))
assert "S300" not in left and "S100" not in left, left
assert "S400" in left, left
